Method of Attack: Distributes information-stealing malware targeting account credentials stored on web browsers, cryptocurrency extensions and wallets, and two-factor authentication plugins
Uses a batch file (AtomicWallet-Setup.bat) to invoke PowerShell commands to elevate privileges
Copies and hides PowerShell executable to execute base64-encoded, AES-encrypted, and GZip compressed PowerShell code
Downloads malware payload from a Discord server and installs it on the host machine
Attack Vector: Fake website impersonating official Atomic wallet portal
Malicious ZIP file download named 'Atomic Wallet.zip' containing malware
Indicators of Compromise: Malware downloaded from a Discord server
Presence of base64-encoded, AES-encrypted, and GZip compressed PowerShell code
Date of Discovery: Monday prior to article publication (exact date not specified)
